description: Permanently delete a key created through an API key, or the calling key itself. Keys created in the console cannot be deleted this way. Pass confirm: true. Returns object api_key.delete with key_id and deleted. To stop a leaked console key, use everyinfra_key_disable. Example: {"key_id": "<from everyinfra_keys>", "confirm": true}. Needs the keys:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

confirm.description: Must be true; the key cannot be restored

name: everyinfra_key_delete
title: Delete an API key
